verdict.rationale: Expensify documents several background automations that run without user action: auto-submitting reports on a schedule, automatic create/submit/approve/reimburse flows, daily accounting sync with automatic export of finalized reports, auto-categorization, and automatic receipt-to-card matching. Users can also configure rules by asking the AI in plain language. Community complaints about categorization accuracy concern the quality of one automation, not whether automations run in the background. Missing for 10: evidence of user-defined custom automations beyond built-in expense workflows (arbitrary triggers or schedules), detailed docs on configuring rules and automations, and independent hands-on corroboration that automations run reliably unattended.
